Replace a generated region between sprefa markers

Usage: ryi-server region [OPTIONS] <TARGET> <ID>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  DL7 file holding the markers
  <ID>      Marker id after sprefa:auto-begin / sprefa:auto-end

Options:
      --generated <GENERATED>  Generated body file, or - for stdin [default: -]
      --apply                  Write the replacement (default: report drift)
      --state <STATE>          Soopy state root for --apply
      --daemon-client          Send this command to the resident daemon (ignored by the server binary)
  -h, --help                   Print help
